requirement: Return a page of antibiotics ordered by creation time descending: apply the optional group and classification filters, project the group name through the navigation, and wrap the page with pagination metadata.

preconditions.text: Two beta-lactams and one macrolide are seeded one minute apart
The group filter matches one stored group
The group filter matches no stored group

inputs.text: No filter, page 2, size 2 (last partial page)
Antibiotic-group filter on Macrolides, page 1, size 10
Group and classification filters combined, page 1, size 10
Group filter with an unknown GUID, page 1, size 10

returns.text: Success with the requested page and its metadata
Each item carries its group ID and group name
Filters narrow the page to the matching antibiotics only
An empty page with zero total items when the filter matches nothing

exception_text: No unhandled exception; the read-only query has no failure branch
